title: Ideas, Authors and Circulation: Intellectual Production from the Early Modern Era to the 19th Century
field: Intellectual history of the Ottoman, Persian and Arab worlds
about: The Orient-Institut Istanbul, Turkey, calls for applications to a postgraduate workshop, 'Ideas, Authors and Circulation', held 14–16 April 2027 for MA and PhD researchers on the Ottoman, Persian and Arab worlds. Documents are sent as a single PDF by email by 8 January 2027.
requirements: MA and PhD researchers working on the Ottoman, Persian and Arab worlds from the early modern period to the nineteenth century

upskill.name: AI for Research & Information Synthesis
why: requirement "MA and PhD researchers working on the Ottoman, Persian and Arab worlds from the early modern period to the nineteenth century" → objective "Compare sources, viewpoints, approaches, products, or alternatives using explicit criteria and structured analytical frameworks."

field "Intellectual history of the Ottoman, Persian and Arab worlds" (title: "Ideas, Authors and Circulation") → objective "Summarize long or complex materials while preserving the main arguments, evidence, conclusions, and important contextual details."
Note: the catalog has no history course; the match covers source analysis and synthesis skills only.
